title: Catalog authorization sessions expire during peak reads
summary: Catalog reads begin receiving authentication failures shortly after a traffic increase, with retries succeeding inconsistently.
precursor: A rollout increased the number of catalog replicas while the identity provider continued issuing short-lived access tokens.
impact: Product pages intermittently fail to load inventory and price details, increasing checkout abandonment.

title: Partner callback signatures rejected after queue delay
summary: Partner callbacks reach the relay over healthy connections but are rejected by request verification.
precursor: A sustained batch of delayed webhook deliveries raised callback age while the partner continued signing events at creation time.
impact: Shipment status updates are delayed, and partner retries are accumulating faster than the relay can drain them.

title: Platform reconciler receives forbidden deployment updates
summary: Reconciliation loops report repeated authorization denials when applying deployment changes in selected namespaces.
precursor: A cluster access review narrowed the reconciler's namespace scope shortly before a routine rollout expanded to additional teams.
impact: Application rollouts remain pending, leaving several customer-facing services on older revisions.

title: Invoice dispatch requests fail at the document gateway
summary: Invoice submissions are rejected at the document gateway, and the dispatcher is retaining work for retry.
precursor: A chart cleanup moved outbound identity settings into a shared values block before the dispatcher release.
impact: New invoices are not delivered to customers on time, and the dispatch queue is growing.

title: Tenant provisioning tokens fail identity validation
summary: Provisioning calls are rejected by the identity boundary even though the workload can reach its dependencies.
precursor: A regional deployment promoted a values file from the staging environment during a production expansion.
impact: New tenant workspaces are not created, delaying customer onboarding and generating support escalations.
